A '''tender''' was an agricultural role within [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] society. Tenders looked after the [[Farm/Legends|farms]] aboard [[Ithorian Herdship]]s. Both [[Iggjel]] and his [[Iggjel's friend|friend]] were tenders-in-training; Iggjel abandoned his training when the [[Mother Jungle/Legends|Mother Jungle]] called to him.<ref name="Iggjel" />
